evidence.excerpt: Inside NVIDIA Halos for Robotics: A Full-Stack Functional Safety System for Physical AI | NVIDIA Technical Blog DEVELOPER Home Blog Forums Docs Downloads Training Join Technical Blog Subscribe Related Resources Robotics English 中文 Inside NVIDIA Halos for Robotics: A Full-Stack Functional Safety System for Physical AI Jun 22, 2026 By Suhas Hariharapura Sheshadri , Riccardo Mariani , Samuel Ochoa , Deep Rodge and Sarah Todd Like Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary Like Dislike NVIDIA launched the Halos for Robotics platform, integrating AI compute (IGX Thor) and a comprehensive safety OS (Halos OS), leveraging over a decade of AV safety R&D, including 18,000 engineering years and 21 billion safety transistors, to deliver a standards-compliant, extensible safety stack for industrial robots, humanoids, and AMRs. The Halos stack unifies hardware and software safety across three layers, with IGX Thor providing IEC 61508 SIL 3 capable platform safety via a dedicated Safety Island, high diagnostic coverage, and advanced error management, while Holoscan Sensor Bridge enables secure, real-time, multimodal sensor integration to the safety compute domain.
